name: aws-content-plugin
description: AWS cloud content creation plugin — presentations, architecture diagrams, animated diagrams, documents, GitBook sites, workshops, and brochures

hooks.command: bash -c 'j=$(cat); cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty" <<<"$j" 2>/dev/null); out=$(jq -r "(.tool_response // .tool_output // empty) | tostring" <<<"$j" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$cmd" == *remarp_to_slides.py* ]] && grep -qiE "warning|error" <<<"$out"; then jq -n --arg m "Build warnings detected. Review output before proceeding." "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:\$m}}"; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *reactive-presentation/references/* ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *reactive-presentation/SKILL.md ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *reactive-presentation/scripts/* ]]; then PROJ="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; [ -f "$PROJ/scripts/eval-skill-behavior.py" ] || exit 0; if pgrep -f "eval-skill-behavior[.]py --skill reactive-presentation" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -n --arg m "[EVAL SKIPPED] reactive-presentation eval already running." "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:\$m}}"; exit 0; fi; mkdir -p "$PROJ/.omc/logs"; nohup python3 "$PROJ/scripts/eval-skill-behavior.py" --skill reactive-presentation > "$PROJ/.omc/logs/eval-reactive-presentation-latest.log" 2>&1 & jq -n --arg m "[SKILL CHANGED] reactive-presentation — $(basename "$FILE"). Eval started (PID=$!) — results at .omc/logs/eval-reactive-presentation-latest.log" "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:\$m}}"; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *.md ]] && head -5 "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "remarp: true"; then python3 -c "import sys; t=open(sys.argv[1]).read(); nl=chr(10); t=t.split(nl+\"---\"+nl,1)[1] if t.startswith(\"---\"+nl) and nl+\"---\"+nl in t else t; slides=t.split(nl+\"---\"+nl); missing=[i+1 for i,s in enumerate(slides) if s.strip() and \":::notes\" not in s]; print(f\"Slides missing notes: {missing}\") if missing else print(\"All slides have notes.\")" "$FILE" | jq -R "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:.}}"; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *.html ]] && [[ "$FILE" != /tmp/eval-* ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *node_modules* ]] && grep -q '"'"'"generator".*"remarp"'"'"' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then jq -n --arg m "[CONTENT COMPLETE] Remarp presentation written: $(basename "$FILE"). Quality gate required: run content-review-agent (>= 85) before deployment." "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:\$m}}"; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *reactive-presentation/references/* ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *reactive-presentation/SKILL.md ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *reactive-presentation/scripts/* ]]; then PROJ="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; [ -f "$PROJ/scripts/eval-skill-behavior.py" ] || exit 0; if pgrep -f "eval-skill-behavior[.]py --skill reactive-presentation" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -n --arg m "[EVAL SKIPPED] reactive-presentation eval already running." "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:\$m}}"; exit 0; fi; mkdir -p "$PROJ/.omc/logs"; nohup python3 "$PROJ/scripts/eval-skill-behavior.py" --skill reactive-presentation > "$PROJ/.omc/logs/eval-reactive-presentation-latest.log" 2>&1 & jq -n --arg m "[SKILL CHANGED] reactive-presentation — $(basename "$FILE"). Eval started (PID=$!) — results at .omc/logs/eval-reactive-presentation-latest.log" "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:\$m}}"; fi'
echo 'AWS Content Plugin loaded. Quality gate (content-review-agent >= 85) is mandatory before deployment.'
